answer: Hold each identity's rewards in a 20-epoch escrow and anchor them to how independently it behaves. Every close, compare grade and vote vectors across all pairs of identities. Any pair that agrees on more than 90% of shared items forfeits both escrows. An orchard of clones run from one model and one prompt agrees almost perfectly, so the farm loses everything unless it pays for a separate model or a real independent judgment per head. That makes each extra head cost real inference, not a copper's worth of compute.
